notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other modified creature with power one or greater.
description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing any other modified creature you control with power one or greater.
One with the Kami triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the sacrificed creature's power that each enter with at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
